Title: EnumerableHelper.Search lambda missing parameter
Description: Expression.Lambda<Func<TEntity, object>>(propertyExpr) omits the ParameterExpression argument, causing ArgumentException 'Incorrect number of parameters supplied for lambda declaration' for all sort columns. Should be Expression.Lambda<Func<TEntity, object>>(propertyExpr, paramExpr).

Title: DynamicSearch combines LambdaExpression nodes
Description: DynamicSearch<T> combines full LambdaExpression objects via Expression.Or (line 79) instead of their bodies (as SearchDynamic correctly does at line 145). This produces an invalid expression tree that throws at runtime. The method body is a near-duplicate of SearchDynamic and should combine MethodCallExpression bodies, not lambdas.
